description: My education, experience, selected projects, and analytical toolkit.

education.details: Relevant coursework: macroeconomics, microeconomics, OOP and design patterns, financial mathematics, calculus, and linear algebra I/II.

points: Selected to support Manulife’s global hedging programs for variable annuity and index-linked products across equity, interest-rate, currency, and fixed-income risk factors.
Will perform daily exposure mapping and produce aggregate risk reports identifying key portfolio risk drivers and informing internal hedging decisions.

experiences.role: Business Technology Analyst Intern, Solutions Architecture
